title: Trabzon gui v1
script:
-- GUI Başlangıç
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

-- Parent Ayarları
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
ImageLabel.Parent = MainFrame

-- Ana Çerçeve Ayarları
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true -- Sürüklenebilir

-- Resim Ayarları (Dönen Resim)
ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
ImageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.2, -50)
ImageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://122609059319189"
ImageLabel.Rotation = 0
ImageLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

-- Animasyonlu Giriş
local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local introTween = tweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)})
introTween:Play()

-- Butonlar
local buttonData = {
    {name = "Sis", func = function() 
        local effect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        effect.Parent = MainFrame
        effect.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        effect.Size = NumberSequence.new(10)
        effect.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
    end},
    {name = "Fire Karakter", func = function() 
        local fireEffect = Instance.new("Fire")
        fireEffect.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        fireEffect.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- Yeşil yanma
    end},
    {name = "Blok Nuke", func = function() 
        for i = 1, 900 do
            local block = Instance.new("Part")
            block.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
            block.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), 50, math.random(-50, 50))
            block.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
            block.Anchored = true
            block.Parent = workspace
        end
    end},
    {name = "Hint T", func = function() 
        local hint = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
        hint.Text = "666 TRAPZON 666"
        wait(1)
        hint.Text = "Ez GAME"
    end},
    {name = "MeepCity", func = function() 
        -- YER TABAKASI OLUŞTURMA
        local layer = Instance.new("Part")
        layer.Size = Vector3.new(1000, 1, 1000)
        layer.Position = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -50, 0)
        layer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        layer.Anchored = true
        layer.Parent = workspace
        -- Hint ve Tool'lar
        local hint = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
        hint.Text = "Welcome here trapzon meepcity"
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end},
    {name = "Bozucu", func = function() 
        -- Oyun rengi siyah olsun
        game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        -- Kötü grafik efekti
        game.Lighting.Brightness = 0.1
        -- Türk Bayrağı efekti
        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head.BillboardGui.Adornee = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head
    end},
    {name = "GLICH", func = function() 
        -- Karakter partisinde animasyon ve sis
        local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
        local fireEffect = Instance.new("Fire", character)
        fireEffect.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255) -- Mavi ve kırmızı yanma
        -- Hint Bozulma
        local hint = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
        hint.Text = "Sürekli Bozulma"
    end},
    {name = "Message", func = function() 
        local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
        msg.Text = "XXXOMER12345678 AND KİCH 🇩🇪"
    end},
    {name = "Model GLİCH", func = function() 
        for _, model in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if model:IsA("Model") then
                local part = model:FindFirstChild("PrimaryPart")
                if part then
                    local glitchEffect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                    glitchEffect.Parent = part
                    glitchEffect.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    end},
    {name = "TSB Animasyon", func = function() 
        -- TSB animasyon kodları
    end},
    {name = "KICH Özel", func = function() 
        -- KICH özel animasyonları
    end}
}

-- Butonları oluşturma
for i, buttonInfo in ipairs(buttonData) do
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Parent = MainFrame
    button.Text = buttonInfo.name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, (i - 1) * 60)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buttonInfo.func)
end
